intro.heading: Beyond the Game. United by the Passion.
intro.body: SL Mini Golf Association is an independent platform dedicated to bringing India's mini-golf community together. It aims to connect players, showcase talent, celebrate achievements and highlight the journeys of individuals contributing to the sport. From local competitions to international participation, the platform creates a space to discover, recognize and celebrate the people behind mini golf.
intro.short: A platform built around the passion for mini golf, bringing players together and celebrating their achievements. Connecting talent, sharing journeys and taking Indian mini golf beyond boundaries.

visionMission.vision: To see mini golf grow beyond boundaries, bringing recognition to Indian talent and building a connected community that inspires future generations of players.
visionMission.mission: To connect mini-golf players, celebrate their achievements, showcase tournament journeys and promote greater awareness and participation in the sport across India and beyond.
